distinct_id.description: Distinct ID the email's engagement events (sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced) are captured under. Defaults to the recipient's email address. The events join the person who has this ID, or start a new person when nobody has it, so pass the ID your app uses for this recipient to see the email on their person. No events are captured when the project's engagement events setting is off. The email goes out either way.

message_data.description: Data for the template's Liquid placeholders, available as `variables`. For example `{"reset_link": "https://..."}` fills `{{ variables.reset_link }}`.

template_id.description: ID of the email template to send, from workflows-list-email-templates. The template must be transactional.
